about_page.title: About This project
about_page.description:
This project stems from a personal curiosity about the fascinating world of cognitive biases. My goal was to create a simple and accessible way for people to discover and understand these mental shortcuts. The content is largely based on the excellent work found at cognition.vsxlabs.com, which was scraped, transformed into an API, and then translated using a combination of open-source tools and AI like Gemini.

It's important to note that the classification and definition of biases can vary from one source to another. This project is inspired by several remarkable references that shape our current understanding. Over time, the application's data will be updated and enriched, drawing from works like those from The Decision Lab, Catalog of Bias, cognition.vsxlabs.com, and the famous Cognitive Bias Codex. These sites have been a major source of inspiration for creating this tool.
